name: fitness-tracker
description: Offline-first, single-user training planner. Deterministic rules engine, phone-first PWA.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && find android/app/src/main/assets/public -type f \( -name '*.jpg' -o -name '*.map' \) -delete
scripts.validate: python3 tools/build_seed.py --check && python3 tools/build_fitnotes_manifest.py --check && python3 tools/build_instructions.py --check && node scripts/validate.js
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && vite build
